Our Story

Who Book Trybe is, and why we exist.

Who We Are

Book Trybe is an interactive space for passionate readers to come together to share, discuss, and celebrate literature from all walks of life. What started as a small circle of readers on July 15th, 2025 has grown into a community with dedicated chapters for books, poetry, drama, and writing.

Why We Were Created

Reading is often solitary — Book Trybe exists to make it communal. We wanted a place where a book isn't finished when the last page turns, but where the real conversation begins.

Draft copy — edit freely

Vision

To build Africa's most engaged literary community, where every reader, writer, and storyteller has a seat at the table.

Mission

To bring readers and writers together through consistent, well-hosted literary conversation — in person and online — and to give emerging African writers and poets a stage.

Community FirstEvery event is built around genuine conversation, not just a book list.
ConsistencyThe Trybe reads, reviews, and discusses on a steady monthly rhythm.
Every Voice MattersFrom first-time readers to published authors, everyone contributes.
Literary RangeBooks, poetry, and drama all have a home here — not just fiction.

Our Activities

Six ways the Trybe reads, discusses, and creates together.

01

Book Review

Monthly deep-dive discussions on a chosen novel, closing with a full live session.

02

Poem Review

A reflective reading and discussion of a chosen poem, hosted by our poetic affairs team.

03

Play Review

Theatrical readings and discussion of a chosen play, hosted by our Director of Theatrical Readings.

04

The Art of Writing

Live sessions with guest writers on craft, hosted for the Trybe's aspiring and working writers.

05

Writers Connect

A space for writers in the Trybe to talk shop, share work, and connect with each other.

06

Author Spotlight

Regular features on authors and poets whose work the Trybe admires and recommends.
